prompts.mikoflame: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Miko sacred boundary flame pixel sprite, TWO equal square cells side by side horizontal transparent strip. Create a crisp chunky pixel-art holy shrine flame suitable downsample32x32. Each cell has one bright flame rising from a tiny ember base at bottom centre. White-hot ivory core, rich sakura pink/magenta outer tongues, a small amount warm gold/orange ember, two floating sakura petals. Frame0 upright flame, frame1 visibly different flickering curling flame. Clearly FIRE with upward tongues, not a rose flower, not an explosion, not an ordinary yellow flame. Occupy central 65% width and 85% height, transparent margins; no ground tile, no frame, no text, no scene. Sparse enough to see an enemy behind it. Shared reference is original Miko shrine pixel palette, replace subject with flame. 2:1 horizontal strip.
prompts.mikodomain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Miko ultimate great shrine domain VFX, TWO equal square cells side by side horizontal transparent sprite strip. Crisp chunky pixel-art symmetric SQUARE sacred barrier seal. Thin bright GOLD outer squared corner brackets, magenta sakura energy filaments following square perimeter, small white/pink petal clusters at four corners, a distinct small stylized shrine torii motif at top centre and bottom centre. Huge transparent empty centre (at least 65% of cell width) so characters remain readable. Frame0 opening seal with separated corner rays; frame1 fully shining square barrier and dispersed petals. Holy Japanese shrine magic, warm gold and sakura pink and ivory white. Very readable silhouette when downsampled32x32; no filled background, no fog, no gradients, no text, no labels, no UI. No fire (separate ability); not a circular aura. Uniform square footprint. Source is original Miko shrine palette reference, make the ULTIMATE visibly grander and more golden. All graphics stay within each equal square cell with transparent margin. 2:1 wide strip.
